description: Formation, catégories et place des adverbes dans la phrase.

questions.question: After 1945, scrap metal merchants and rag-and-bone men …… gave up their place to antique dealers.
questions.explication: `Progressively` (« progressivement ») convient. *Lately* et *lastly* ne vont pas avec *after 1945* ; *backwards* est un adverbe de lieu.

questions.question: Even the most seasoned thrill-seekers were …… astonished by the amusement park amenities.
questions.explication: Il faut un adverbe qui renforce le sens d'*astonished* à cause de *even* : `quite`.

questions.question: Their brand has been an Internet sensation since its launch, with its on-trend …… timeless creations.
questions.explication: Un adverbe de contraste (« pourtant ») souligne la qualité atemporelle des créations : `yet`.

questions.question: …… a dish but last night he forgot the main ingredient!
questions.explication: Avec un adverbe à connotation négative en début de phrase, on inverse sujet et verbe comme dans une question : `Rarely did the chef miss`.

questions.question: The company is currently run by a bold entrepreneur who has …… been in college.
questions.explication: Un adverbe de rareté est attendu (« presque jamais ») : `hardly ever`.

questions.question: Steve Marsh …… but he should do it before the meeting.
choix: hasn't called yet the head office
yet hasn't called the head office
hasn't yet called the head office
hasn't called the head office yet
questions.explication: Pour signifier « pas encore », `yet` se place en fin de proposition, sans séparer le verbe de son COD.

questions.question: The Saint-Louis covered market is …… a small affair with few vendors but high-quality products.
questions.explication: `Just` (« juste ») se place devant l'article et s'intègre au sens. *Enough* et *too* seraient placés après l'adjectif (*too small an affair*).

questions.question: As a committed spokeswoman of organic food, she …….
choix: from the farm cooks every day fresh produce
cooks from the farm fresh produce every day
cooks every day fresh produce from the farm
cooks fresh produce from the farm every day
questions.explication: On ne peut séparer le verbe de son COD : `cooks fresh produce from the farm every day`.

questions.question: Mrs. Kellogs' training course has not started …… but she would like to have the syllabus as well as the list of books that will be required.
questions.explication: `Not yet` (« pas encore ») convient. *Already* et *always* ne collent pas ; *still* décrit une action qui dure.

questions.question: …… the burglars entered their house.
questions.explication: Adverbe négatif en tête → inversion sujet / verbe : `Hardly had they left when`. La conjonction *that* n'est pas correcte.
